source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one independently randomized, complex photographic test scene in which an original adult performer visibly plays a dedicated two-antenna theremin without contact, using the attachment only for scoped visible appearance guidance.
subject: An original adult theremin performer and a powered wooden theremin cabinet with two distinct antennas.
setting: A rain-streaked glass-roofed botanical conservatory at night, with tropical foliage and distant lightning visible beyond the panes.
event: The performer gives a live recording performance, controlling pitch and volume in two separate noncontact hand fields.
visual_priorities: The complete powered cabinet, vertical rod antenna, horizontal loop antenna, both hands, and clear air gaps are simultaneously legible.
The attached portrait affects only visible adult face, hair, makeup placement, and skin-surface finish for an original performer.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial performance photograph inside a rain-streaked glass-roofed botanical conservatory at night. An original adult performer stands at a powered wooden theremin cabinet during a live recording while distant lightning silhouettes tropical leaves beyond the panes. The instrument has a clearly visible vertical metal pitch rod on its right and a horizontal loop antenna on its left; her right hand shapes the pitch field beside the rod while her left hand shapes the volume field above the loop, with plainly visible air separating both hands from both antennas. A glowing power lamp, warm vacuum-tube window, speaker grille, and simple analog dials make the cabinet read as a self-contained electronic instrument. Frame an eye-level 35 mm environmental portrait from head to mid-thigh so the face, entire cabinet, both antennas, both forearms, and every air gap remain unobstructed. Sodium-orange rain light outside contrasts with soft cyan instrument glow and a neutral bounced key. Use Image 1 only to guide the visible adult face, long dark wavy hairstyle, subtle warm eye makeup, natural lip color, and luminous skin-surface finish; portray an original adult performer.
